name: The Resort at Kapalua Bay
positioning: Residential-style resort on Kapalua Bay in West Maui, with multi-bedroom residences that have full kitchens and private lanais
best_for: Families and groups who want multi-bedroom residences with full kitchens
Beach lovers who want Kapalua Bay just beyond the resort
Golfers who want access to the Plantation Course

facts.text: The resort is set along the shores of Kapalua Bay in West Maui.
Each residence has a full kitchen, multiple bedrooms, spacious living areas and a private lanai.
Residences have marble bathrooms, hardwood floors and in-residence laundry.
The resort has three pools, including the Sunset Pool with daybeds and a waterslide.
Keiki Club is the resort's program for younger guests.
The Restaurant at Kapalua Bay serves modern Hawaiian cuisine with panoramic ocean views, inspired by the traditional canoe house.
The Restaurant at Kapalua Bay was formerly called Cane & Canoe.
The Spa at Kapalua Bay offers open-air treatments and thermal and hydrotherapy experiences.
At Kapalua Bay Beach, resort guests get complimentary loungers, umbrellas and towel service, with water-sport rentals nearby through Aqualani.
The nearby Plantation Course was designed by Ben Crenshaw and Bill Coore.
Resort guests get exclusive rates and tee time access at Kapalua Golf.
The nearby Kapalua Coastal Trail is an easy two-mile walk with cliffs, tide pools and ocean views.

highlights.text: The Signature Residences are five individually designed three- and four-bedroom retreats.
Cliff House is a historic waterfront venue above Namalu Bay, originally built in 1940.
Select residences offer grills and private pools on their lanais.
Cultural Ambassadors share Hawaiian history and traditions through workshops.
Chef Justin Purpura's three-course tasting menu is served nightly at The Restaurant at Kapalua Bay.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service, and Kahului airport (OGG) is about 33 miles away.
The property moved from the Montage portfolio to Marriott Bonvoy in March 2026.
WhataHotel notes that the Kapalua location requires travel time to other parts of Maui.
